=46rom Jeff Laake:
"Stratum level estimates are typically combined by

D=3D sum j=3D1 to m D_i*A_i/Sum j=3D1 to m A_i

Simply put you estimate the abundance in each stratum which is density ti=
me area, add them up across all strata and divide by total area. Forget =
for a minute that this is distance sampling and pretend that you are doin=
g strip or quadrat sampling and ask yourself what you would do then. Dis=
tance sampling is only a small tweak to estimate p for incomplete detecti=
on. Nothing more and nothing less."

timates, which are still ~20% of the total calculated as the sum from the=
samples. Here is one stratum as an example, with estimate-by-sample outp=
